text_en: After this the Lord appointed seventy others and sent them on ahead of him in pairs to every town and place where he himself intended to go.
text_cn: 此后，主另外选定了七十二人，派遣他们两个两个地在他前面，到他自己将要去的各城各地去。

text_en: He said to them, “The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few; therefore ask the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into his harvest.
text_cn: 他对他们说：“庄稼多而工人少，所以你们应当求庄稼的主人，派遣工人来，收割他的庄稼。

text_en: Go on your way. See, I am sending you out like lambs into the midst of wolves.
text_cn: 你们去罢！看，我派遣你们犹如羔羊往狼群中。

text_en: Carry no purse, no bag, no sandals; and greet no one on the road.
text_cn: 你们不要带钱囊，不要带口袋，也不要带鞋；路上也不要向人请安。

text_en: Whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace to this house! ’
text_cn: 不论进了哪一家，先说：愿这一家平安！

text_en: And if anyone is there who shares in peace, your peace will rest on that person; but if not, it will return to you.
text_cn: 那里如有和平之子，你们的和平就要停留在他身上；否则，仍归于你们。

text_en: Remain in the same house, eating and drinking whatever they provide, for the laborer deserves to be paid. Do not move about from house to house.
text_cn: 你们要住在那一家，吃喝他们所供给的，因为工人自当有他的工资；你们不可从这一家挪到那一家。

text_en: Whenever you enter a town and its people welcome you, eat what is set before you;
text_cn: 不论进了哪座城，人若接纳你们，给你们摆上什么，你们就吃什么。

text_en: cure the sick who are there, and say to them, ‘The kingdom of God has come near to you. ’
text_cn: 要医治城中的病人，并给他们说：天主的国已经临近你们了。

text_en: But whenever you enter a town and they do not welcome you, go out into its streets and say,
text_cn: 不论进了那座城，人如不接纳你们，你们就出来，到街市上说：

text_en: ‘Even the dust of your town that clings to our feet, we wipe off in protest against you. Yet know this: the kingdom of God has come near. ’
text_cn: 连你们城中粘在我们脚上的尘土，我们也要给你们拂下来；但是你们当知道：天主的国已经临近了。

text_en: I tell you, on that day it will be more tolerable for Sodom than for that town.
text_cn: 我告诉你们：在那一日，索多玛所受的惩罚，要比这座城容易忍受。”

text_en: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the deeds of power done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
text_cn: “苛辣匝因啊，你是有祸的了！贝特赛达啊，你是有祸的了！因为在你们那里所行的异能，如果行在提洛及漆冬，她们早已披上苦衣，坐在灰尘中，而改过自新了。

text_en: But at the judgment it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon than for you.
text_cn: 但是在审判时，提洛和漆冬所受的惩罚，要比你们容易忍受。

text_en: And you, Capernaum, will you be exalted to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades.
text_cn: 还有你，葛法翁啊！莫非你要被高举到天上吗？将来你必被推下阴府。

text_en: “Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me, and whoever rejects me rejects the one who sent me. ”
text_cn: 听你们的，就是听我；拒绝你们的，就是拒绝我；拒绝我的，就是拒绝那派遣我的。”

text_en: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, in your name even the demons submit to us! ”
text_cn: 那七十二人欢喜地归来，说：“主！因着你的名号，连恶魔都屈服于我们。”

text_en: He said to them, “I watched Satan fall from heaven like a flash of lightning.
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“我看见撒殚如同闪电一般自天跌下。

text_en: See, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy; and nothing will hurt you.
text_cn: 看，我已经授予你们权柄，使你们践踏在蛇蝎上，并能制伏仇敌的一切势力，没有什么能伤害你们。

text_en: Nevertheless, do not rejoice at this, that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven. ”
text_cn: 但是，你们不要因为魔鬼屈服于你们的这件事而喜欢，你们应当喜欢的，乃是因为你们的名字，已经登记在天上了。”

text_en: At that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and said, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and the intelligent and have revealed them to infants; yes, Father, for such was your gracious will.
text_cn: 就在那时刻，耶稣因圣神而欢欣说：“父啊！天地的主宰，我称谢你，因为你将这些事瞒住了智慧及明达的人，而启示了给小孩子。是的，父啊！你原来喜欢这样做。

text_en: All things have been handed over to me by my Father; and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, or who the Father is except the Son and anyone to whom the Son chooses to reveal him. ”
text_cn: 我父将一切都交给我，除了父，没有一个认识子是谁；除了子及子所愿启示的人外，也没有一个认识父是谁的。”

text_en: Then turning to the disciples, Jesus said to them privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see what you see!
text_cn: 耶稣转过身来私下对门徒说：“见你们所见之事的眼睛，是有福的。

text_en: For I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see what you see, but did not see it, and to hear what you hear, but did not hear it. ”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：曾经有许多先知及君王希望看你们所见的，而没有看见；听你们所听的，而没有听到。”

text_en: Just then a lawyer stood up to test Jesus. “Teacher, ” he said, “what must I do to inherit eternal life? ”
text_cn: 有一个法学士起来，试探耶稣说：“师傅，我应当做什么，才能获得永生？”

text_en: He said to him, “What is written in the law? What do you read there? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“法律上记载了什么？你是怎样读的？”

text_en: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself. ”
text_cn: 他答说：“你应当全心、全灵、全力、全意爱上主，你的天主；并爱近人如你自己。”

text_en: And he said to him, “You have given the right answer; do this, and you will live. ”
text_cn: 耶稣向他说：“你答应得对。你这样做，必得生活。”

text_en: But wanting to justify himself, he asked Jesus, “And who is my neighbor? ”
text_cn: 但是，他愿意显示自己理直，又对耶稣说：“毕竟谁是我的近人？”

text_en: Jesus replied, “A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell into the hands of robbers, who stripped him, beat him, and went away, leaving him half dead.
text_cn: 耶稣答说：“有一个人从耶路撒冷下来，到耶里哥去，遭遇了强盗；他们剥去他的衣服，并加以击伤，将他半死半活的丢下走了。

text_en: Now by chance a priest was going down that road; and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
text_cn: 正巧有一个司祭在那条路上下来，看了看他，便从旁边走过去。

text_en: So likewise a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
text_cn: 又有一个肋未人，也是一样；他到了他那里，看了看，也从旁边走过去。”

text_en: But a Samaritan while traveling came near him; and when he saw him, he was moved with pity.
text_cn: 但有一个撒玛黎雅人，路过他那里，一看见就动了怜悯的心，

text_en: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, having poured oil and wine on them. Then he put him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
text_cn: 遂上前，在他的伤处注上油与酒，包扎好了，又扶他骑上自己的牲口，把他带到客店里，小心照料他。

text_en: The next day he took out two denarii, gave them to the innkeeper, and said, ‘Take care of him; and when I come back, I will repay you whatever more you spend. ’
text_cn: 第二天，取出两个银钱交给店主说：请你小心看护他！不论余外花费多少，等我回来时，必要补还你。

text_en: Which of these three, do you think, was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of the robbers? ”
text_cn: 你以为这三个人中，谁是那遭遇强盗者的近人呢？”

text_en: He said, “The one who showed him mercy. ” Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise. ”
text_cn: 那人答说：“是怜悯他的那人。”耶稣遂给他说：“你去，也照样做罢！”

text_en: Now as they went on their way, he entered a certain village, where a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
text_cn: 他们走路的时候，耶稣进了一个村庄。有一个名叫玛尔大的女人，把耶稣接到家中。

text_en: She had a sister named Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet and listened to what he was saying.
text_cn: 她有一个妹妹，名叫玛利亚，坐在主的脚前听他讲话。

text_en: But Martha was distracted by her many tasks; so she came to him and asked, “Lord, do you not care that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her then to help me. ”
text_cn: 玛尔大为伺候耶稣，忙碌不已，便上前来说：“主！我的妹妹丢下我一个人伺候，你不介意吗？请叫她来帮助我罢！”

text_en: But the Lord answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are worried and distracted by many things;
text_cn: 主回答她说：“玛尔大，玛尔大！你为了许多事操心忙碌，

text_en: there is need of only one thing. Mary has chosen the better part, which will not be taken away from her. ”
text_cn: 其实需要的惟有一件。玛利亚选择了更好的一分，是不能从她夺去的。”
